name: Misty Vol.1
source:
Misty Vol.1 is a detective mystery adventure game set in modern-day Japan and starring the young private investigator Ryū Kamishiro. The game consists of five unrelated cases that can be accessed in any order from the main menu. These cases range from seemingly mundane matters to thefts, mysterious disappearances and murder investigations.

This volume contains the following cases: Strange Naked Body, Red Fountain, Murderer's Laboratory, Tail Lights Disappearing in the Old City, and Decaying Family Tree.

The game largely consists of text-only descriptions and dialogues, though some locations and scenes are accompanied by sparse black and white digitized photos. The player is presented with a text list of locations in the city, and much of the gameplay is dedicated to repeatedly visiting them, searching areas and questioning suspects. 

The player is awarded points depending on the efficiency and the speed of the investigation. It is possible to accuse suspects and attempt to solve the case at any point, though doing so without sufficient evidence will result in failure. The game saves the progress automatically; it is possible to restart the investigation only by deleting the save file.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/misty-vol1]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
Misty Vol.1是一款侦探悬疑冒险游戏，以现代日本为背景，由年轻私家侦探Ryū Kamishiro主演。该游戏由五个不相关的案例组成，可以从主菜单中以任意顺序访问这些案例。这些案件的范围从看似平凡的案件到盗窃、神秘失踪和谋杀调查。

本册包含以下案件：奇怪的裸身、红色喷泉、杀人犯的实验室、老城里消失的尾灯、腐烂的家谱。

该游戏主要由纯文本描述和对话组成，尽管某些地点和场景伴有稀疏的黑白数字化照片。玩家会看到城市中地点的文本列表，游戏的大部分内容都是反复访问这些地点、搜索区域和询问嫌疑人。

玩家根据调查的效率和速度获得积分。随时都可以指控嫌疑人并试图破案，尽管在没有足够证据的情况下这样做会导致失败。游戏自动保存进度；只需删除保存文件即可重新开始调查。

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/misty-vol1]MobyGames[/url]]
